steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a sheet cake pan with cooking spray. Sift together the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.

In a mixing bowl, beat together 3 cups of sugar with canola oil with an electric mixer on low speed until the mixture is smooth; add 3 eggs one at a time, and beat again to combine. Beat in zucchini and vanilla until well combined. Beat the flour mixture into the sugar mixture by fourths, alternating with 1/4 cup of buttermilk after every portion of flour mixture. Mix the batter for 1 minute on medium-high speed, and pour the batter into the prepared baking pan.

In a bowl, mix together the cream cheese and 1/4 cup of sugar until thoroughly combined, then mix in 1 egg until the cream cheese mixture is smooth. Spoon dollops of the cream cheese here and there over the cake batter, and swirl the cream cheese mixture through the batter with a table knife to make a marbled effect. Sprinkle the milk chocolate and semisweet chocolate chips over the cake.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the chocolate portion of the center of the cake comes out with moist crumbs, 25 to 30 minutes. Cool on a rack.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate Swirl Zucchini Sheet Cake
raw_recipe.description: With a unique twist on the favorite chocolate zucchini cake, this recipe adds an attractive swirl of cream cheese that will have everyone asking for more.

review.reviewBody: This made enough batter for a 13x9 and at least 12 cupcakes. Baked the cupcakes for 22 minutes and the 13x9 for ~55 minutes. I used only 2 cups of sugar and used 3/4 c. oil and 3/4 c. unsweetened applesauce. It was delicious!

This cake turned out perfectly with a few changes to the directions.
After reading the reviews, I used a sheet cake pan plus an 8X8 square pan because I did not want the cake overflowing in my oven. I did substitute 1/2 C of applesauce for 1/2 C of the oil and decreased the sugar by 1/2 cup. Also I added 1 tsp of almond extract to the cream cheese mixture while beating it. It took about 40 minutes baking time in glass pans before both cakes were done. Next time I make this recipe I will try it with egg replacement since one family member is allergic to eggs.

Everybody in the house loved it. Have made it 3 times at this point. I followed advice in other reviews and used 2 cups of sugar instead of 3 cups. 3 cups would definitely be too sweet. I also put some of the batter in a second square pan as suggested since it made a lot of batter. I used almond milk instead of buttermilk because I didn't have any. I added a little vanilla to the cream cheese mixture the second time, and it definitely adds to the taste. I replaced all of the oil with unsweetened apple sauce. It came out nice and moist. I used bittersweet chocolate chips (60% cacao). I cooked it for an hour after seeing other reviewers did this. It definitely needed an hour to bake. Next time I'm going to try replacing the sugar with agave syrup and see how it turns out.

Added about 1/2 cup of extra flour as batter very runny. Did make 6 cupcakes from it also ... or might have overflowed pan as it does rise a lot. Does take longer to cook . But pretty good. I did substitute avocado oil for canola and used natural cane sugar instead of white sugar.

This recipe was easy to follow. I followed it except I didn't have buttermilk so I used plain yogurt. It turned out great. It's very moist and flavorful. The batter is runny but it bakes and makes a brownie like cake. It comes out perfect if you use a sheet pan and a 9x13 pan. That way, the thickness is right for the 30 minute baking time. I liked it so much, I made it again for a church function.

My mom made this recipe and it broke my heart that this recipe failed her. But the recipe is the problem, not my mom's baking. As so many others have commented, the bake time wasn't correct, and the pan size wasn't appropriate. But my 2 main concerns about this cake is WAY too much oil, and the zucchini should be squeezed before using. Many bakers know this about using shredded veggies, but my mom follows recipes to a T, a perfect T, so she ends up with very wet cake that never completely baked in the middle, despite leaving it in the oven for way longer than instructed. The edges taste good! This recipe has all of components of an awesome cake, but if a baker is going to post a recipe online for everyone to see, they need to include ALL instructions! Some recipes can handle unsqueezed zucchini, but NOT THIS ONE. Not to mention this cake is literally shiny because it has so much oil in it. Halve the oil, or even less than half.

This is a very delicious, chocolate dessert for any and all chocolate lovers. The cream cheese batter swirl just sets it all off!! Very good use of extra zucchini in the garden!! I used only semi-sweet mini chips on the top since I am not a milk chocolate fan. I also added a tsp of ground cinnamon for some extra flavor. I agree with some of the other people who have rated this recipe---baking time is at least 1 hr total for the 9x15 pan. I have made this a few times and found that by putting a loose foil cover on about 1/2 way through the baking process it keeps the edges from getting too dry. Going to have a family get together in a few weeks and plan on making this again for that occasion.

Definitely too much batter for one 9x13 pan. I also would make a dozen cupcakes with part of the batter. Baking time is closer to 45 to 50 minutes if you put all the batter in the cake pan. Otherwise a very good recipe. I topped it with white chocolate and semisweet chips, coconut and pecans and it was delicious. Will definitely make again.
It is necessary to squeeze a good amount of moisture out of zucchini before adding it to the batter. That should fix the soupiness and baking times.

I have made this recipe twice and it was delicious. I did not change the recipe and I used a 17x11 in sheet cake pan. It fills the pan but does not over flow. I think if a 13x9 in pan is used, it should be split into 2 pans. It would be less dense , bake faster and be more like a sheet cake.

Great recipe! I used butterscotch chips instead of milk chocolate and it tasted great. It did take a little longer to bake than the recipe said -- I would probably bake it 40 minutes next time. It made 9 extra cupcakes besides the sheet pan.

Followed recipe as written. It overflowed the sheet cake pan and took at least 20 minutes extra bake time to get the middle set. Very moist, almost too gooey, and a bit bland for all the ingredients needed. I will draw an x through this one.
It was alright. Not the best tasting.

Absolutely FANTASTIC!! When you bite into the richness of this cake your mouth melts with every bite. We gave a piece to our neighbor who shared some with her husband who just had to let his buddies know about this wonderfully moist cake he enjoyed. We are taking neighbors' orders. Trust me, it is that delicious. I rated this 5 stars but it deserves 10 stars, it's that good!!!

This is a great recipe. Based on previous reviews about the size of pans, I used 3 deep dish pie pans and that was perfect. I also doubled the recipe for the cream cheese. What a great way to use zucchini :)
I followed this recipe to a T and it turned out delicious! So moist! Loved the creme cheese swirl with the chocolate. I'll be making this sheet cake again! Thank you for sharing Linda!

I’m still waiting for this to cook in the middle. Time is way off. So is the size of the pan. I added flour as well as the batter was to runny. 
Too much fuss for poor results.
used 1 cup whole wheat and 2 cups white flour, only 2 cups sugar, 1 and 1/3 cups of oil, 3/4 cup of chips

This recipe is a keeper in my stash of cake recopies. My family and I really enjoyed the moist, chocolate taste of this dessert. Most of my family didn't believe there was zucchini in it. The title of the cake has "Sheet Cake" in it, but I over looked this and put the batter in a 9 by 13 baking dish which was almost too small. Consequently, it took about an hour to cook. Next time I will put the batter in a sheet cake pan like it calls for. This is a great cake for family get togethers and church pot luck dinners.

this is for a sheet cake size pan. prior reviews some used 13 x 9. this will make a 13x9 and a loaf pan if you don't have a sheet cake pan. moist, delicious, one of the best cakes I have ever eaten. I followed recipe exactly. my family and grandkids love it!
